Scope: All 68 manuscript-evaluated split contrasts; 1000 within-split permutations per contrast
Interpretation: Observed shifts are unlikely to be explained by random within-split group labeling.
Limitation: A robustness analysis; it does not establish pathway causality or clinical prediction.

Scope: 25 removed genes across all 68 manuscript-evaluated contrasts
Interpretation: Single-gene removal rarely changed effect direction, supporting a distributed score.
Limitation: Tests one removed gene at a time within the existing frozen coefficient set.

Scope: Top-contributor concentration across all 68 manuscript-evaluated contrasts
Interpretation: Low contribution concentration supports a multi-gene rather than single-gene score architecture.
Limitation: Observed contribution fractions do not identify causal genes or cell sources.

Scope: 18 alternative coefficient/gene-selection threshold settings evaluated over 36 contrasts outside the strict-three sensitivity anchor set per setting
Interpretation: Transfer directionality remained high across the evaluated threshold grid.
Limitation: Sensitivity settings do not replace the frozen coefficients used in the manuscript analysis.
